dict.string: MacBridge controls applications such as Safari, Mail, Finder, Terminal, and System Events when you request an action.
MacBridge needs full Calendar access to read, create, update, and delete events on your behalf.
MacBridge needs Calendar access to read and manage events on your behalf.
MacBridge needs full Reminders access to read, create, update, and delete reminders on your behalf.
MacBridge needs Reminders access to read and manage reminders on your behalf.
MacBridge needs Contacts access to search and use your contacts when requested.
